news.headline: Piper Sandler initiates INNIO at Overweight with $21 price target
news.summary: Piper Sandler started coverage with an Overweight rating and a $21 target, citing demand for gas-engine power from data centers and the grid. The target is about 40% above the mid-teens share price but well below Morgan Stanley's $40.

news.headline: Innio (NASDAQ:INIO) Stock Jumps 9.3% - Time to Buy?
news.summary: INIO rebounded about 9% intraday to roughly $15 a day after a 7.5% drop. The stock is still trading at about half its $27 June IPO price.

news.headline: INNIO N V Ord Shs Stock (INIO) Moved Down by 7.48% on Nov 10: A Full Analysis
news.summary: Shares fell 7.5% amid worries about regulatory pushback on AI data-center buildouts. The article also flags the lock-up expiry around Nov 30/Dec 1, which it says covers about 646.5M sponsor and insider shares (about 86% of shares outstanding).

news.headline: Innio (NASDAQ:INIO) Shares Climb 10.7% - Time to Buy?
news.summary: INIO rose about 11% on Nov 3. The analyst roundup shows Citi trimming its target to $21 (Neutral) and Morgan Stanley lifting its target to $42 after Q3, following October cuts by JPMorgan (to $33) and BNP Paribas Exane (to $35).

news.headline: INNIO Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results with Revenue Up 57%, Net Income Up 176% and Adjusted EBITDA Up 70%; Raises 2026 Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Q3 revenue was about $1.17B (+57%) and adjusted EBITDA was $245M (+70%, 21% margin), on $2.2B of equipment orders ($1.8B from data centers). Backlog reached about $8.0B. FY2026 guidance was raised to $3.9-4.0B revenue and $780-800M adjusted EBITDA, and the Aggreko partnership was extended to 2031.

news.headline: INNIO signs 620MW gas engine order with undisclosed US data center developer
news.summary: An undisclosed U.S. mega-campus developer ordered another 620 MW of containerized Jenbacher J624 gensets, booked in Q3. That lifts this customer's total orders to about 1.72 GW after the 1.1 GW July order.

catalysts.label: IPO lock-up expiry
catalysts.detail: The 180-day lock-up from the June 2026 IPO ends around Nov 30/Dec 1. Sponsor Advent and other insiders hold the large majority of shares, so the stock faces a potential supply overhang and possible secondary offerings. This is a structural event, not an operating one.

catalysts.label: Q4 / FY2026 results and first FY2027 guidance
catalysts.detail: The first full-year report as a public company. Watch delivery against the raised $3.9-4.0B revenue / $780-800M EBITDA guide, data-center order intake and the backlog conversion timeline. Date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Further data-center gigawatt orders
catalysts.detail: INNIO has announced repeated multi-hundred-MW to multi-GW Jenbacher orders (VoltaGrid 2.3 GW and 1.5 GW, a 1.72 GW cumulative mega-campus customer, a 450 MW U.S. energy company). New order announcements are the main near-term driver.

pulse: INNIO (Jenbacher gas engines) is growing fast on behind-the-meter power for AI data centers: Q3 revenue rose 57% to about $1.17B, backlog doubled to about $8B, and FY2026 guidance was raised again. The stock still trades around $14-15, roughly half its $27 June IPO price, weighed by concerns about AI power-build regulation and by the Dec 1 lock-up expiry covering most of the share count. New coverage keeps coming: Piper Sandler initiated at Overweight with a $21 target on Nov 13, while other targets range from $21 (Citi, Neutral) to $40 (Morgan Stanley).
